channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: AWS IAM now provides role manager to set up IAM roles automatically
item.description: Today, AWS announces the general availability of role manager, a capability in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) that automatically sets up the IAM roles your AWS services need. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EKS now supports advanced Kubernetes control plane configuration parameters
item.description: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) now supports configuring parameters for Kubernetes control plane components including the scheduler, controller manager, and API server. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Global View now offers an interactive map view for AWS Regions and AWS Local Zones
item.description: Today, AWS announces the addition of an interactive map view to AWS Global View in the AWS Management Console, providing a visual way to explore AWS Global Infrastructure. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Quick adds deny by default for custom permissions
item.description: Amazon Quick custom permissions now include deny by default, a governance setting that automatically restricts new AI capabilities before they reach users. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Quick now supports data loss prevention with Microsoft Purview
item.description: Amazon Quick now integrates with Microsoft Purview to enforce data loss prevention (DLP) policies across your Quick environment. Organizations need to ensure that sensitive files aren't shared outside approved channels. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer supports manual assignment of queued agent-first callbacks
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now lets agents view and self-assign queued agent-first callbacks alongside emails, tasks, and chats. (1 source: aws)
